title: Scarlet Monastery
order_note: Sorted by recording id: C (cinematics), M (in-engine cutscenes), T (gameplay transmissions); unit barks follow their trigger group. Interleaving of C/M/T is not confirmed.

lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: You again. This time, you will be purged from Lordaeron.
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]You again. This time, you will be purged from Lordaeron.[/"Angry"]

lines.speaker: Sally
lines.text: My champion, destroy these monsters!

lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: For the Scarlet Crusade!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Forsaken, attack!

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: We’ve retaken Tirisfal Glades. The zealots retreat to their monastery.
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]We’ve retaken Tirisfal Glades. The zealots retreat to their monastery.[/"Angry"]

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We should storm their stronghold and exterminate them for good.
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]We should storm their stronghold and exterminate them for good.[/"Angry"]

lines.speaker: Memories of Landen
lines.text: Survival is the real victory, and peace is its reward.

lines.speaker: Memories of Landen
lines.text: Never lose sight of that.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Lady Sylvanas. I think we should return to the Undercity.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’ve pushed back the Crusade, but at great cost. If we assault the monastery now...

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We Forsaken can't replenish our numbers. Every loss brings us closer to extinction. Is taking the monastery truly worth that risk?

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: I see the wisdom of your counsel. We will claim this victory, and be content in securing our territory.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I will apprise the Argent Dawn of battle’s outcome. Should the Crusade stir again, the Forsaken will be the first to hear of it.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: It was good to stand beside you both. Know that I will always count you as an ally.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You... were useful. Try not to let those paladins change that.
lines.raw: ["Squint" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]You... were useful. Try not to let those paladins change that.[/"Squint"]

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: The Crusade will rise again. The Light compels them to destroy us.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Perhaps. But I think that their hatred would drive them with or without the Light.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: And I believe that there are those who would wield the Light in other ways. Maybe even in defense of the Forsaken.

lines.speaker: Scourge Assassin
lines.text: So the Scarlet Crusade and the Forsaken have bled each other dry.

lines.speaker: Scourge Assassin
lines.text: Then the hour of the Scourge will soon be at hand.

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Your intelligence was accurate, Leonid. Now for the battle itself.

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: The path to the Scarlet Monastery is heavily fortified. Our numbers are limited, so we must strike with discretion and precision.

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: You are to slip behind enemy lines, break their defenses, and eliminate their commanders.

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: But be warned: if the tide turns against us, I will not hesitate to call for a retreat. Move swiftly, before victory evades our grasp.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It will be done, Dark Lady.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Our troops are on the move. We need to clear out the Scarlet Crusade's defenses or they'll be marching into a death trap.

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Many Forsaken have fallen, but the victory is still within reach!

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: We have lost half of our forces the Crusade's defenses. Do not allow this battle to drag on!

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: We cannot maintain the siege for much longer! Finish this, now!

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Enough! I will not sacrifice any more Forsaken to a lost cause! Fall back to the Undercity!

lines.scene: Scarlet Crusade.Archers.Scarlet Crusade Archers Approach Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Those archers will make short work of our army. Eliminate them.

lines.scene: Scarlet Crusade.Archers.Scarlet Crusade Archers Defeated Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The high ground is ours. Let's push forward!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Dark rangers are skirmishing with crusaders across the forest. My sisters can join us if we come to their aid.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I have heard of a barracks nearby where the Crusade is keeping captive Forsaken troops. We should rescue them if we can.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: With us, soldiers! We march on the Scarlet Monastery!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Slaughtered, all of them. This is what awaits us if the Crusade wins.

lines.scene: Scarlet Crusade.Captain.Scarlet Crusade Captain Discover Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Our forces will be hard pressed to break that shield wall. Flank the Scarlets and ambush their captain.

lines.scene: Scarlet Crusade.Captain.Scarlet Crusade Captain Approach Q
lines.speaker: Captain Tychos
lines.text: The undead strike from the high ground! Do not let them pass!

lines.scene: Scarlet Crusade.Captain.Scarlet Crusade Captain Defeated Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The phalanx is broken! Our army pushes forward!

lines.scene: Scarlet Crusade.Captain.Scarlet Crusade Captain Defeated Q
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Crusade will respond in kind. We must reach the monastery soon.

lines.scene: Scarlet Crusade.Inquisitors.Scarlet Crusade Inquisitors Discover Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That inquisitor will use the Light to incinerate our forces. We need to slay him!

lines.scene: Scarlet Crusade.Inquisitors.Scarlet Crusade Inquisitors Approach Q
lines.speaker: Inquisitor Kerran
lines.text: Vile monsters! Burn in holy fire!

lines.scene: Scarlet Crusade.Inquisitors.Scarlet Crusade Inquisitors Defeated Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Good riddance. Now our army can advance.

lines.scene: Scarlet Crusade.Cannons.Scarlet Crusade Cannons Approach Q
lines.speaker: Crusader Artonius
lines.text: No! Your siege ends here!

lines.scene: Scarlet Crusade.Cannons.Scarlet Crusade Cannons Meat Wagons Bastion Q
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Crusade has only one line of defense remaining. The monastery lies ahead!

lines.scene: Scarlet Crusade.Cannons.Scarlet Crusade Cannons Meat Wagons Bastion Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then it's time to end this battle!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp Start Fight Q
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: We will attack as one!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp Start Fight Q
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: At your side, milady!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp Renault Taunt 01 Q
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: Face me, monsters!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp Renault Taunt 02 Q
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: You shall all be purified!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp Renault Taunt 03 Q
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: None can oppose the Scarlet Crusade!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp Renault Rescue Q
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: You dare strike at the High Inquisitor?!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp Renault Taunt 04 Q
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: Your wretched existence ends here!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp Sally Revive Taunt Q
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: Fight on, my champion!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp Sally Taunt 1 Q
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: The Light protects those who serve it!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp Sally Taunt 2 Q
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: We will be victorious!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp Sally Taunt 3 Q
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: Drive back these heathens, Mograine!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp Sally Taunt 4 Q
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: Let the flame of salvation burn!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp End Fight Q
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: They are gaining ground, milady! We must fall back to defend the monastery!

lines.scene: Scarlet Camp.Scarlet Camp End Fight Q
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: Very well. One day, these unholy abominations will pay for their treachery!

lines.scene: Scarlet Crusade.Cannons.Scarlet Crusade Cannons Discover Q
lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Captain! Our meat wagons can take down that tower, but we need to get rid of the cannons first!

lines.speaker: Forsaken Ranger
lines.text: I serve the Banshee Queen!

lines.speaker: Forsaken Ranger
lines.text: Greetings!

lines.speaker: Scarlet Footman
lines.text: Attack!

lines.speaker: Scarlet Marksman
lines.text: I'll mount your head on a wall!

lines.speaker: Scarlet Footman
lines.text: To arms!

lines.speaker: Scarlet Footman
lines.text: Attack!

lines.speaker: Crusader
lines.text: For Honor! For Freedom!
